purpose: Classify insurance contracts to their IFRS 17 measurement model: Premium Allocation Approach (PAA) for coverage periods of 12 months or less, Variable Fee Approach (VFA) for direct-participating contracts with investment-linked features (not reinsurance), or General Measurement Model/BBA as the default. Returns measurement_model (GMM/VFA/PAA), eligible_models, paa_eligible, vfa_eligible flags, and direct_participating indicator. Root node of the ifrs17-measurement-conformance chain. IFRS 17 live since Jan 1 2023. Zero network, zero PII.
